richiami.difetto: During drilling to install the seatbelt mast base plate the drill may penetrate too far and damage the brake hoses under the floor.
richiami.rimedio: Carry out a check of the brake circuit pipe situated vertically to the belt mast attachment (potentially behind the thermal protection plate). Repair if necessary

richiami.difetto: Cracking of the leisure battery tray may occur such that the battery may fall onto the carriageway.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the original battery tray with a strengthened version.
